text:
Anya: FYI found two issues while updating the observability guide: the tracing-hook example in `console/tracing.md` uses `trace_id` as a string but our SDK returns numbers in TS snippets. Also the sample dashboard JSON has a stale link to `/dashboards/old-traces` which 404s.

Theo: oof. the snippet extractor failed on CI because of the type mismatch. error was `Type 'number' is not assignable to type 'string'` in `examples/ts/tracing-sample.ts`.

Sam: quick fix options: change the snippet to cast to string (`String(traceId)`) or patch the SDK types to accept number | string. prefer docs-level fix first.

Anya: agree docs-first. i'll change the TS snippet to `const traceId = String(event.trace_id)` and add a short comment explaining why. will also update the dash JSON to point to `/console/tracing/traces`.

Theo: please also add a tiny unit test in `docs/snippets/tests/tracing.test.ts` that runs the extractor so CI will catch regressions.

Sam: note: update the image alt text in `static/img/console/tracing-ux.png` to match the new path. and fix the broken internal link in the migration guide.

Docbot: deploy-preview created: https://deploy-preview-491--docs.redwood-inference.com | CI: lint + snippet-extract + linkcheck queued. REVIEWERS: Theo, Anya.

Anya: pushed branch `docs/tracing-snippet-type-fix`. commands: `git checkout -b docs/tracing-snippet-type-fix && git add examples/ts/tracing-sample.ts dashboards/tracing.json docs/migration/tracing.md && git commit -m "docs: normalize trace_id to string in TS snippet; update dashboard link" && git push origin docs/tracing-snippet-type-fix`.

Theo: quick review done, left one nit about explaining why SDK uses numbers. LGTM after nit.

Sam: merged at 1749999050 (PR #491). thanks! :tada:
